mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) trend over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening consumer confidence and construction activity, increasing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPIAUCSL increase above 305.0 for two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuation multiples and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 305.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase above 4.0% and employment decline from prior month indicate labor market stress, reducing consumer spending power and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS declines from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS declines from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 305.0 and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% indicate active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 305.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
